name: DeformableIngot3D
description: Procedural Dynamic 3D Ingot / Mesh Object for GDevelop with camera raycast vertex detection, on-the-fly dynamic remeshing, real-time vertex deformation (Push, Pull, Hammer Strike, Smooth, Flatten), and thermal simulation.
shortDescription: Procedural deformable 3D ingot with on-the-fly remeshing & camera raycasting.
author: Twillion

customObjectTypes.name: DeformableIngot3D
customObjectTypes.description: Procedural 3D deformable ingot object with camera raycasting and on-the-fly remeshing.

properties.name: Tint
properties.label: Base Metal Color
properties.description: RGB tint for the ingot surface

properties.name: EnableThermal
properties.label: Enable Thermal Simulation
properties.description: Track vertex temperature and heat glow

properties.name: HeatDiffusion
properties.label: Heat Diffusion
properties.description: Rate at which heat equalizes across welded surface vertices

properties.name: ForgingTemperature
properties.label: Minimum Forging Temperature (°C)
properties.description: Metal below this temperature resists forge strikes

properties.name: IdealForgingTemperature
properties.label: Ideal Forging Temperature (°C)
properties.description: Temperature at which full plasticity is reached

properties.name: AnvilEnabled
properties.label: Enable Anvil Constraint
properties.description: Prevent the workpiece from passing below the local anvil plane

properties.name: AnvilLocalZ
properties.label: Anvil Local Z
properties.description: Normalized local Z position of the anvil plane

eventsFunctions.name: DeformAtScreenPoint
eventsFunctions.sentence: Deform _PARAM0_ at screen pointer (_PARAM1_, _PARAM2_) on layer _PARAM3_ (Brush: _PARAM4_, Radius: _PARAM5_, Strength: _PARAM6_, Falloff: _PARAM7_)
eventsFunctions.description: Uses camera raycasting from screen coordinates to detect hit vertices on the 3D ingot and apply deformation (Push, Pull, HammerBlow, Smooth, Flatten).

eventsFunctions.name: DeformAtWorldRay
eventsFunctions.sentence: Deform _PARAM0_ along ray from (_PARAM1_, _PARAM2_, _PARAM3_) in dir (_PARAM4_, _PARAM5_, _PARAM6_) (Brush: _PARAM7_, Radius: _PARAM8_, Strength: _PARAM9_, Falloff: _PARAM10_)
eventsFunctions.description: Casts a 3D ray from world origin/direction to intersect the mesh and apply deformation.

eventsFunctions.name: RaycastFromScreen
eventsFunctions.sentence: Raycast from screen point (_PARAM1_, _PARAM2_) on layer _PARAM3_ against _PARAM0_
eventsFunctions.description: Casts a ray from screen coordinates through the 3D camera to test intersection and cache hit coordinates.

eventsFunctions.name: HasRaycastHit
eventsFunctions.sentence: _PARAM0_ has a valid raycast hit
eventsFunctions.description: Returns true if the last raycast intersected this 3D mesh.

eventsFunctions.name: RaycastHitX
eventsFunctions.sentence: the last raycast hit X position on _PARAM0_
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the world X position of the last raycast intersection.

eventsFunctions.name: RaycastHitY

eventsFunctions.description: Returns the world Y position of the last raycast intersection.

eventsFunctions.name: RaycastHitZ
eventsFunctions.sentence: the last raycast hit Z position on _PARAM0_
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the world Z position of the last raycast intersection.

eventsFunctions.name: RaycastHitNormalX

eventsFunctions.name: RaycastHitNormalY

eventsFunctions.name: SetSubdivisions

eventsFunctions.sentence: Remesh _PARAM0_ with subdivisions (_PARAM1_, _PARAM2_, _PARAM3_) (Preserve deformation: _PARAM4_)
eventsFunctions.description: Dynamically tessellates or coarsens the 3D mesh on the fly. When preserve is true, existing surface offsets are retained.

eventsFunctions.name: ResetDeformation
eventsFunctions.sentence: Reset _PARAM0_ to original un-deformed ingot shape
eventsFunctions.description: Restores the pristine un-deformed geometry.

eventsFunctions.name: SmoothRegion
eventsFunctions.sentence: Smooth _PARAM0_ at local point (_PARAM1_, _PARAM2_, _PARAM3_) with radius _PARAM4_ (Strength: _PARAM5_, Iterations: _PARAM6_)
eventsFunctions.description: Applies Laplacian relaxation across vertices in the specified radius.

eventsFunctions.name: VertexCount
eventsFunctions.sentence: the total vertex count of _PARAM0_
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the number of vertices in the procedural 3D mesh.

eventsFunctions.name: TriangleCount
eventsFunctions.sentence: the total triangle count of _PARAM0_
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the number of triangles in the procedural 3D mesh.

eventsFunctions.name: IsDeformed
eventsFunctions.sentence: _PARAM0_ has been modified / deformed

eventsFunctions.name: ForgeAtCameraOffset
eventsFunctions.sentence: Strike _PARAM0_ from camera center offset (_PARAM1_, _PARAM2_) on layer _PARAM3_ (Face radius: _PARAM4_, Impact velocity: _PARAM5_)
eventsFunctions.description: Raycasts from the center of the camera with a pixel offset, then applies a temperature-aware hammer strike. The visible hammer can be any separate 3D object.

parameters.description: Horizontal offset from camera center in pixels

parameters.name: OffsetY
parameters.description: Vertical offset from camera center in pixels

parameters.name: FaceRadius
parameters.description: Hammer face radius in world units

parameters.name: ImpactVelocity

parameters.name: PlaneOffset
